info.name: Veriko API: SPEI transfer verification against the Banxico CEP
info.description: Requests for every public machine-to-machine operation of the Veriko API, generated from the Bruno collection in this repository. Import the `Veriko production` environment, set `api_key` and start with the Getting started folder. Requests that validate a transfer consume quota. See README.md.

item.name: Getting started
item.description:
Guided flow. Run the requests in order, from 01 to 13.

Steps 01 to 04 consume quota. Step 05 polls until the verdict is terminal and needs the Bruno runner or the Postman collection runner to repeat itself.

Step 13 deletes the webhook endpoint created in step 08; leave it out of runs where you keep the endpoint.

request.description:
Validates a SPEI transfer from its fields and returns the verdict in the same response.

Consumes quota. Every accepted validation counts against the plan, and a `not_found` is billed like a `valid`.

A `202` response with `meta.async_reason: sync_deadline` means Banxico took longer than 45 seconds. The validation continues in the background; continue with step 05.

The body holds example data. A transfer that does not exist returns `not_found`.

Query parameters:
- `async` (optional): Set to `1` to queue the validation. The response is `202` with the validation identifier.

Saves `validation_id`, `queued_validation_id` (on 202).

Reference: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/v1/validations/validate-direct
Guide: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/how-to/validate-spei

request.description:
Polls `queued_validation_id` until the validation reaches a terminal state.

The terminal states are `valid`, `not_found`, `cep_unavailable`, `invalid`, `returned`, `failed` and `error`. `queued` and `processing` are not terminal.

Honors `Retry-After` and `meta.next_poll_after_seconds`. The script waits that long, sends the last `ETag` in `If-None-Match`, and repeats the request in the runner up to 30 times or until `expires_at`.

A single send without the runner returns one reading.

Uses `queued_validation_id`, saved by an earlier request. Run the requests in the order of the folder, or set the variable in the environment.

Saves `queued_validation_etag`, `validation_status`.

Reference: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/v1/validations/get-validation
Guide: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/concepts/async-validations

Query parameters:

- `banks` (optional): Comma-separated SPEI codes (up to 50); returns the validations whose sending or receiving bank is any of them.
- `amount_min` (optional): Inclusive minimum amount, as a number.
- `amount_max` (optional): Inclusive maximum amount, as a number.
- `retry_state` (optional): Retry cycle state: `pending`, `resolved`, `exhausted`, or `cancelled`.

request.description:
Sends the same validation twice under one `Idempotency-Key`. The second send replays the first response.

Consumes quota. Every accepted validation counts against the plan, and a `not_found` is billed like a `valid`.

Send this request twice. The first send creates the key in `idempotency_key`; the second reuses it and carries `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, without consuming quota again.

A different body under the same key returns `422 idempotency_key_reused`; a send while the first is running returns `409 idempotency_key_in_progress`. Keys last 24 hours.

Clear `idempotency_key` to start over.

Query parameters:
- `async` (optional): Set to `1` to queue the validation. The response is `202` with the validation identifier.

Saves `idempotency_key`, `validation_id`.

Reference: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/v1/validations/validate-direct

item.name: Update the retry policy of a validation (destructive)

request.description:
Activates an automatic retry policy for a validation with a `not_found`, `cep_unavailable` or `error` verdict.

Destructive request. Changes the retry cycle of the validation. It is not accepted for validations from a bulk import, already resolved, or older than seven days.

Uses `validation_id`, saved by an earlier request. Run the requests in the order of the folder, or set the variable in the environment.

Reference: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/v1/validations/update-validation-retry-policy
Guide: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/how-to/configure-retry-policy

Cancels the active automatic retry cycle of a validation.

Destructive request. Ends the retry cycle with `terminal_state: cancelled`. A cycle that is not active returns `422 retry_not_active`.

Uses `validation_id`, saved by an earlier request. Run the requests in the order of the folder, or set the variable in the environment.

Reference: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/v1/validations/cancel-validation-retries
Guide: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/concepts/retry-policy

Queries Banxico again for the payment status of a `valid` validation and moves it to `returned` if the payment was returned.

It queries Banxico and does not consume quota.

Uses `validation_id`, saved by an earlier request. Run the requests in the order of the folder, or set the variable in the environment.

Guide: https://docs.veriko.mx/en/how-to/inspect-validations
